title: Legacy Insecure TLS Protocols (TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1) are Enabled
description: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 suffer from known cryptographic weaknesses (BEAST, POODLE) and must be disabled in favor of TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.
expected: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 Client/Server DisabledByDefault = 1 and Enabled = 0
impact: Man-in-the-middle attackers can force protocol downgrade attacks and decrypt encrypted network streams.
remediation_guidance: Disable legacy TLS in HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1.
